name: Medina of Essaouira (formerly Mogador)
description: Essaouira is a walled port town on Morocco's Atlantic coast, laid out in the late 18th century with a European-style military plan. Its ramparts and sea bastions still face the ocean, while the medina inside is a tidy grid of lanes. For centuries it was a busy seaport, connecting Morocco and the Saharan interior with Europe and beyond.
